# Which market is actually worth your day?

> Free calculator for farmers market, craft fair and festival vendors: what each market really earns after booth fee, drive, product cost, waste and card fees, profit per hour against your target wage, break-even sales and which market to drop or reprice. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
